summary: Iteration 89 - Alquileres % ocupación mensual (por propiedad + cartera). Backend: 16/16 functional tests PASS (main agent's 5 + 11 new edge cases: case a 10 conf+5 bloq on 30-day month -> 25 disp/40.0%, empty month, month-crossing reservation and month-crossing block split, leap Feb 2028=29, 12-month ordering, cancelada not counted, encurso/finalizada counted, fully blocked month -> disp 0/pct 0 without div-by-zero, unknown pid 404, missing params 422, general == sum of per-property rows, fixture A161 identical in both endpoints). 3 FAIL: malformed desde/hasta ('abc', '2026-13', '2026-00') return 500 instead of 400. UI (qa_temp@vera.test, desktop): the 'Ocupación de la cartera' panel renders on the Propiedades tab with year 2026, Promedio 7.6%, 12 bars, prev/next year working (2025/2027 -> 0%), and the detail toggle shows the A161 row [22.6,0,16.1,16.7,19.4,0,0,16.1,0,0,0,0], which matches the API. The per-property 'Ocupación por mes' panel under the property's Reservas tab shows Promedio 2026 7.6%, 12 bars, a working tooltip and year nav. Both panels are CONSISTENT. No page errors. Search and calendar still render. The change in routes_rentals.py only adds code (git diff checked).

minor.issue: Malformed desde/hasta (e.g. 'abc', '2026-13', '2026-00') causes an unhandled ValueError in _meses_rango/_month_bounds and returns 500. These should return 400 (validate with a regex like ^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$ or try/except -> HTTPException(400)).

issues: Bars under 30% use #6b6b6b on a near-black card, so low occupancy months (most real months, ~16-22%) are barely visible. Use a brighter neutral or the accent color.

The recharts tooltip shows the raw key 'pct : 22.6%'. Set a name on <Bar> (name='Ocupación'). It could also show ocupadas/disponibles noches; OcupacionPropiedad already passes these in chartData but does not use them.
On API failure both panels silently show 'Promedio 0%' with an empty chart and no error message.

action_items: Return 400 (not 500) for malformed desde/hasta in both ocupación endpoints.

Optional/business: 'Promedio {año}' is a simple mean of the 12 monthly pcts. Months with disponibles=0 (fully blocked) and future months count as 0% and pull the average down, which contradicts the rule that blocked days should not penalize. Consider a weighted average (sum ocupadas / sum disponibles) or excluding months with disponibles=0.
Optional: improve contrast of low-% bars and rename the tooltip label 'pct'.
critical_code_review_comments: _meses_rango/_month_bounds do not validate input, which causes the 500s above.
GET /ocupacion makes one _occupied() query per property (N+1). This is fine for the current portfolio (1 property) but should become a single $in query if the portfolio grows.
OcupacionGeneral.tsx and OcupacionPropiedad.tsx duplicate the chart block, MESES_LABEL and colorPct (~25 lines). Extract a shared <OcupacionChart/>.

Pre-existing stale regression tests unrelated to this change: test_rentals.py (discount brackets changed; public prereserva now requires accepting conditions -> 400), test_rentals_prereserva_calendar.py (same acceptance requirement), test_rentals_shortstay_monto.py (hardcoded property no longer exists -> 404). These need updating; they are not caused by iteration 89.
